description:
I'm Roger Kessler. After more than 35 years working around storm damage, home restoration, and weather-related problems, I've learned that a little preparation can prevent a lot of trouble.

On this channel, I break down El Niño, winter weather, and what it could mean for your home and household — with practical checklists, overlooked risks, common mistakes, and things I would prepare before the storm arrives.

I don't predict the weather. I help you prepare for what it can do.
